Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
The unit must be out of service.

Connect frequency counter to pin 1 and pin 31 
 from connector card A (1L7X )

Turn master control switch to auto. Position 
 and start the turbine.

When speed arrive to FSNL we adjust speed 
 by means of " raise lower " switch to 95 % from rated speed (5089 ) RPM.

Push and hold over speed test button of SSZB 
 card on ( 1L1N ) to increase turbine speed ( >100% & < 110 % ) 
 speed.

Raise speed by means of "raise lower" switch 
 to 110% and check the turbine tripped and alarm over speed appear and record the trip speed (5589) RPM

If the turbine not trip at 110% and arrive to 
 112% from rated speed. It must be tripped by mechanical over speed.

If the turbine not trip at 112% from rated 
 speed by mechanical over speed . it must be tripped by emergency stop push 
 button then you must change speed trip card ( QOXC ) in 1L0J.

Repeat test again from steps ( 1 to 6 ) and 
 record speed when the turbine trip after changing the card (QOXC ) in 1L0J

Disconnect the frequency counter, the master control switch to off position and check 
 the ratchet system start.
